notes.background: icons are transparent; draw them over a frame or panel
notes.frame: draw the 26x26 frame, then the 24x24 icon at iconOffset; items take their rarity's frame, abilities the 'ability' frame
notes.scaling: nearest-neighbour at whole multiples only (2x-3x on phones, 3x-4x on the TV)
notes.abilityIcons: one icon per rules-pack ability, keyed by the ability id unchanged (art key 'icons.<ability id>', e.g. icons.wizard.fire_bolt). Each has a 24x24 rect in abilities_by_id.png and a natively drawn 48x48 rect2x in abilities_by_id@2x.png (use it at 2x scale and above). The icon is a full-bleed tinted plate: draw it inside the 'ability' frame, or on its own
